description: The chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family, comparing various multilingual BERT models. The horizontal axis is labeled "family" and contains categories in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with a tick label interval of 5 and no units specified. Each language family category contains a group of six bars, representing different models: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red). The bar groups are not sorted by a specific order, and error bars indicating standard deviation are shown for each bar. The values of the bars vary across language families and models; for example, IE-Indic has relatively high values for mBERT-R2 (around 18), XLM-R2 (around 18), mBERT-B2 (around 25), and XLM-B2 (around 22), while Isolate and Uralic have very low values across all models. No bars are visually emphasized.
